{{Quote|The Jedi Council has just granted us approval to build a Jedi temple on Alaris Prime.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=CouncilApproves.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The '''Jedi temple''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was built at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] within a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] run by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The [[Jedi temple/Legends|temple]] was used to store a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] found on Alaris Prime after it was recovered by the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].

==Description==
{{Quote|We need to build a Jedi temple to house the holocron.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiees|audio=BuildATemple.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The [[Jedi temple/Legends|Jedi temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] was erected by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers in a [[Chewbacca's camp|camp]] run by the leader of the Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="GB" /> The temple was constructed using [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] and [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and was placed within the range of a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] to keep the building running efficiently.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> It had a square base with a column on each corner and a tower in its center, similar to other types of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] temples. The Alaris Prime temple was [[Color/Legends|gray]] with orange stripes on the higher level of the tower and at the midsection of each column.<ref name="GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|A holocron is a priceless repository of ancient information. It should not be left lying in the wilderness.|audio=WhatIsholocron.flac|Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Wookiee_Jedi_base.png|thumb|right|300px|The Jedi temple was built in Chewbacca's camp.]]
The Jedi temple was constructed<ref name="GB" /> at some point between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> during the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for the [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of Alaris Prime fought between the [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|rightful]] Wookiee colonists and the company known as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. The construction came about in response to the discovery of a [[Jedi holocron (Alaris Prime)|Jedi holocron]] within a [[Shoran's camp|camp]] belonging to Chewbacca's ally, [[Shoran]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], acting as an [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]] to the Wookiees on behalf of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], gained permission from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to build the temple, where the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] could be kept safe. With its construction, Jinn sent his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to Alaris Prime to gather the holocron and store it within the temple, as only a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual could hold it. Within the temple, the holocron was able to generate a steady supply of nova [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] for Chewbacca.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi temple on Alaris Prime was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> It appeared in the sixth level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign titled "Allies and Jedi," where the player can learn how to build Jedi temples and use them to create Padawans and collect holocrons. The temple costs 180 units of carbon and twenty-five nova crystals to build. The player is instructed to create a generic Padawan unit at the temple, whom Jinn introduces as Kenobi. If the player has enough resources, they can create more Padawans and additional temples.<ref name="GB" />
